versions.title: How to restart your router
versions.body: Unplug the router for 30 seconds, plug it back in, and wait for the lights to settle.
versions.author: support

versions.title: Tips for restarting your router
versions.body: Use the dedicated restart button or unplug for 30 seconds. When lights blink, the router is booting.
versions.author: support

versions.title: Como reiniciar o seu router
versions.body: Desligue o router durante 30 segundos e ligue novamente. Aguarde as luzes estabilizarem.
versions.author: support
